name: Analisis de Consistencia de Ropa
description: Detecta inconsistencias temporales en patrones, texturas y comportamiento fisico de la ropa en video.
useCase: Identifying AI-generated full-body videos through clothing rendering anomalies
mechanism: Tracks clothing pattern details (stripes, logos, text), wrinkle dynamics, and fabric physics across frames. AI-generated videos often exhibit pattern warping, disappearing details, physically incorrect fabric behavior, or texture flickering on clothing.
source: Khormali, A. & Yuan, J. (2022) - DFDT: An End-to-End DeepFake Detection Framework, Applied Sciences
algorithm: Texture Tracking + Pattern Consistency + Physical Simulation Comparison
parameters: Texture features: LBP + Gabor, Pattern tracking: template matching, Physics: cloth simulation comparison
